CustomField.description: The financial campaign this code discounts. A code is only accepted on an order filed to this same campaign, so a Hospitality Guide code cannot be redeemed against anything else. Restricted to revenue-generating campaigns: a discount on a campaign that takes no money is meaningless.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Which campaign this code discounts. Only revenue-generating campaigns can be chosen.
CustomField.label: Campaign

lookupFilter.errorMessage: Pick a revenue-generating campaign. A discount code on a campaign that takes no money has nothing to discount.
